checks: Signing out/offline cannot expose previous user's finance/task payload or service-worker cache.
Keyboard-only user completes task, handoff and review; mobile controls remain 44px and usable at 200% zoom.
Automated axe plus manual evidence recorded; no blanket WCAG certification based only on an automated scan.

checks: Representative member/guest/head essential journeys remain understandable and operable with keyboard/mobile/zoom; record open failures by AD ID rather than claiming certification from axe alone.
No required action/help is clipped, hidden behind optional setup or dependent on drag; all five bottom targets meet the house target and offline/sign-out cannot expose the previous account.

Run fresh-account/deep-link/empty/error/conflict/retry and mobile first-action smoke checks against the actual deployed revision. Label simulated data and provider/human limitations separately from genuine hosted observations.

No simulated sign-in or missing gateway is counted as live scoped acceptance; member/guest/admin fixtures remain separate, no real roster is seeded and no production release follows automatically.

Human results remain pending until observed; zero open P0/P1 is required for a green release gate.

work: Use the original representative first-time/experienced/guest/head cohort and intended scopes. Observe finding-specific journeys: first work/owner/date/action within two minutes after basic orientation, contact discovery, correct service selection, short-ref use, review versus submission, safe retry and optional disclosure/tour behavior.

Close each AD finding only with implementation plus its observed/automated evidence as appropriate; give unresolved findings owner/impact/next action. Missing participants/provider setup keeps human acceptance pending, not simulated green.
checks: Actual newcomer records distinguish observed success from assisted/failed/not-run tasks; automation, login counts and guide checkboxes cannot satisfy the two-minute/90%human targets.

Unresolved essential usability/accessibility failures cannot be waived by completing all feature prompts. A blank-affiliation late joiner and an off-domain scoped guest have appropriate work/help without learning internal codes.

Real selected-file flow verified if school/provider setup exists; otherwise adapter code/local tests marked external-blocked, not fully integrated.

Use readable filenames/owners and recoverable consent/denied/expired states; member work does not require provider IDs or a connection just to continue unrelated tasks.

A genuine configured selected-file flow uses named controls and safe retry, with provider-denied behavior recorded honestly; no connection state is falsely shown successful.

interface: User-triggered rendition/export creates new immutable app asset/Drive copy with manifest and destination classification; source and approved snapshot stay distinct.
steps: Export explicitly selected Google-native final rendition into private app evidence, hashing bytes and binding caption/use in the submitted revision.
Implement authorized selected-file/data copy into approved Drive folder with current destination-permission check and audit. Separate FIN/PRISM destinations; no membership-wide sensitive mirroring.
Add resumable progress/error handling and duplicate-copy prevention; preserve originals until a verified archival disposition.
checks: Changed Drive/Canva source cannot rewrite approved app snapshot or retained decision hash.
Private FIN/PRISM file cannot be copied into broader folder without explicit authorized reclassification/policy; deny unsafe destination.
Retry does not create endless duplicate files; revoked destination access yields clear recoverable failure.

work: Explain which final revision/copy goes to which approved destination in plain language; show readable filename/ref and progress before/after export. Keep original/approved snapshot distinct and technical manifest details scoped.
Use resumable error/retry and duplicate prevention; no provider-folder code entry for normal selection and no broad sensitive mirroring.
checks: A user can distinguish original working file from submitted immutable copy and recover an interrupted export without duplicate files or rewritten approvals.
Renamed source/destination/ref labels preserve bindings; lost or overly broad destination access fails with a safe repair path and no private payload leak.

title: Implement one-way core-calendar publishing
interface: App remains authoritative; explicit core-safe app events map to one approved core calendar, with source version, remote IDs, tombstones and durable token lifecycle.
steps: Implement separately authorized connection and explicit app-to-Google publish/update/cancel jobs; document external-edit conflict policy.
Add idempotent mapping, retry/backoff, revoked-auth repair, last-sync/error view, and safe token storage. No private task/mentee/finance data in general calendar.
If reconciliation reads use incremental tokens, handle HTTP410 by rebuilding mapped remote cache without deleting canonical app events.
checks: Create/update/retry/cancel results in one correctly timed remote event, no resurrection after tombstone.
Expired/testing/revoked token shows stale state and fallback; never claims synced after failure.
Private event/export preferences cannot leak through shared calendar title/description/location.

work: Distinguish Add a copy from verified automatic sync; show the last successful update and plain repair status. Connection is optional, with useful local app calendar when disabled/revoked.
Use readable event titles and named authorized calendar selection; keep external edits/conflicts understandable without implying private events are shared.
checks: A failed/revoked sync cannot say current/synced, and retry/cancellation cannot duplicate or resurrect the event; the local next-action calendar remains usable.
Declining sync adds no mandatory member setup, and private event/ref/title cannot leak through a broad calendar or repair preview.

checks: Stolen/expired/reused linking code cannot attach another member; invalid webhook source rejected.

Repeated dispatch deduplicates logically and carries no private financial/evaluation contents.

work: Make opt-in link/unlink and failure/relink states understandable; Telegram remains a supplemental alert channel, never necessary to find authoritative work.
Keep generic scoped deep links, digest/quiet-hour explanations and no disabled-module navigation or automatic account messaging.
checks: Unlink/revocation stops delivery without hiding in-app pending work; failed/expired link codes have a clear safe restart and cannot bind another member.
Retry cannot create duplicate logical alerts or leak restricted titles/content; no unrequested message is sent while testing the UI.

checks: Wrong email/expired invite/OTP replay cannot gain guest access; unverified email cannot link to existing school member.
Sensitive email is generic with authenticated link and never contains receipt/feedback text.
Missing sender/DNS/quota blocks external verification and activation rather than returning fake sent messages.

work: Give guests one clear current entry route with exact-invite/expiry/wrong-account help and safe return; do not require understanding SMTP, tokens or identity-link internals.
Keep provider-unavailable entry/fallback honest and optional; no activation on untested sender and no guest connection/setup burden for unrelated work.
checks: A guest can recognize expired/wrong-account/undelivered entry and use a permitted recovery route without leaking invite existence or taking over a school identity.
Missing sender/quota keeps activation visibly blocked, not Sent; safe retry cannot redeem an invite twice or expose private mail contents.

checks: Two concurrent overlapping confirmations cannot both succeed; adjacent nonbuffered slots behave correctly.
Expired hold cannot block indefinitely if scheduler is down; setup/cleanup buffers count.
Request submission or a calendar event alone cannot masquerade as official room reservation.

work: Model explicit Requested/Held/Officially confirmed/Cancelled outcomes and safe alternative/conflict reasons that the later UI can present without database terminology. Reuse stable qualified short-reference conventions.
Keep buffers/exclusion/hold expiry and institutional evidence authoritative; do not flatten submission or a calendar event into reservation confirmation.
checks: Domain responses carry a safe human-actionable pending/conflict/confirmed distinction and immutable ref/evidence version, without revealing another private meeting.
Concurrency/expiry/retry preserve one valid confirmation; a short ref or requested slot cannot bypass official confirmation authority.

Change/cancel updates actual reservation/calendar without stale duplicates.

Preserve safe entries on stale availability/conflict; show the permitted next response and clear cancelled/confirmed details on mobile/keyboard without a separate generic control console.
checks: A requester can choose an alternative after conflict without reentering safe information or mistaking a held/requested slot for confirmed.
Named action/confirmation,44px mobile controls and keyboard operation retain private-meeting boundaries and idempotent calendar updates.

Successor gets explicitly granted records, not automatic raw evaluations; every record has archive/dispose/hold/carry disposition.

A successor follows the actual scoped handover tasks with recorded acknowledgment when observed; missing custody/human/recovery proof stays pending and raw FIN/PRISM never transfers implicitly.

title: Audit the integrated build, release eligible scope and hand over
refs: Sections 3/6/11/12/14/15; all enabled feature acceptance criteria
files: docs/build/release-gate.md; docs/uat/*; docs/admin-guide.md; docs/deployment.md; docs/recovery.md; docs/turnover.md; targeted fixes/tests
interface: Final report names exact release revision, enabled/disabled/externally-blocked modules, security/UAT/recovery evidence, verified production target and successor operations.
steps: Read current state/contracts and targeted high-risk code, not all files indiscriminately. Audit transitive access, same-term/guest revocation, stale approvals, config privilege changes, outbox, recovery and private exports; add focused regression tests for genuine findings.

Reconcile all required F01–F26 coverage against implemented or deliberately disabled optional scope. Verify actual mixed-background human UAT, authority/privacy decisions and restore evidence; do not pretend simulated review is independent security certification.

This prompt includes deployment of the tested eligible build to the already identified organization-owned production targets if gates passed, account access exists and migrations/backups/rollback are verified. Ask only for genuinely missing target/input. Otherwise deliver a complete candidate with precise blockers. Prepare head/admin/custodian instructions and event/manual-fallback rehearsal; do not send rollout messages or invoke live end-term closure.
checks: Zero open critical/high release blockers and required checks pass on the actual release revision; no skipped optional module is misreported as complete.
Production smoke tests, privacy boundaries and OAuth verified if released; otherwise final status explicitly remains candidate/blocked.
Second-custodian/successor tasks and account custody are recorded; handover requires real acknowledgment, not a generated claim.

work: Reconcile every adoption finding and P35-P62 U result against the exact eligible release revision: implemented evidence, observed human result, owner/impact for residual issues, or deliberately disabled optional scope. Recheck the real enabled ordinary-member/guest/head/custodian experience, not a feature count.

Require actual representative newcomer first-work/contact/service/status/ref/recovery journeys and the original two-minute/90%essential-flow proposed targets, with task results/time/wrong turns/help. Repeat affected checks after material fixes; no green gate from a generated guide or simulated council.

Prepare short role-specific operating/fallback instructions that match the released screens; include actual second-custodian/successor operation. Essential/high adoption barriers join existing security/privacy/restore/provider blockers before release; if blocked, deliver an honest candidate, not a false deployment claim.
checks: Every AD finding has a truthful disposition and supporting release-revision evidence; unfinished essential usability/accessibility work or missing actual newcomer UAT blocks a green release.

Production smoke/role instructions agree on readable IDs, applicable review states, working help/first action, disabled modules and safe error recovery; no optional connection or affiliation disclosure is required for essential work.
